description: Energy, forces or fixed-cell relaxation of one library structure with ASE and GPAW or CP2K. You choose the structure, backend, functional, cutoff, k-points, charge, spin, which elements stay fixed, the optimizer and the compute request. Returns the energy (eV), maximum free force (eV/Angstrom), SCF and force convergence recomputed by the controller from native logs, steps, evidence and cost. Cost grows roughly with the cube of the atom count; check atom counts in the catalog and start with single points. The emt backend is a fast non-DFT test surrogate (is_dft false). A converged calculation does not establish that the method is adequate for the scientific question.

structure_id.description: Structure from the library; it must fit the atom limit.

task.description: single_point for energy and forces; optimize for a fixed-cell relaxation.

xc.description: Exchange-correlation functional; null only for emt.

cutoff_ev.description: Plane-wave cutoff (GPAW) or density cutoff (CP2K) in eV; null only for emt.

kpts.description: Three positive Monkhorst-Pack k-point counts for GPAW, or null for the Gamma point (required for CP2K and emt).

spin_multiplicity.description: 2S+1; it must match the electron count parity.

fixed_elements.description: Element symbols whose atoms stay fixed during optimization; may be empty.

optimizer.description: Optimizer for task optimize; null for single_point.

fmax_ev_per_angstrom.description: Force convergence threshold for optimize; null for single_point.

max_steps.description: Optimizer step limit for optimize; null for single_point.

wall_seconds.description: Wall-time limit; cpus x wall_seconds is reserved from the compute budget. A timed-out run is reported as an error with its last checkpoint as evidence.
